description: Defines the SerialWorker class for serial execution of jobs on a ThreadPool, including nested WorkItem class, retry/backoff logic, and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: SerialWorker
classes.description: Manages serial execution of work items on a ThreadPool with retry and backoff support.

classes.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem
classes.description: Abstract class representing a unit of work to be executed on a worker thread and followed up on the origin thread.

methods.name: SerialWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing retries and backoff policy.

methods.name: WorkNow
methods.description: Posts work to the ThreadPool if not already scheduled.

methods.name: IsCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the worker has been cancelled.

methods.name: GetBackoffEntryForTesting
methods.description: Returns current backoff state for testing.

methods.name: CreateWorkItem
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a new work item.

methods.name: OnWorkFinished
methods.description: Pure virtual method called after work item completes, to process results.

methods.name: AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the SerialWorker instance.
